description: Only bin/lib/prompt-loader.ts builds a path into plugin/templates/prompts/ (through paths.ts pluginTemplatePath): loadPrompt() checks every prompt's sha256 against EXPECTED_PROMPT_HASHES (D-12) before it is sent to a model, so a second reader would bypass the hash pin and let an edited prompt reach the provider. Everything else calls loadPrompt(slug), or builds a request with prompt-request.ts buildPromptRequest(slug, values).
